interpretation: Purposefully constructed learner scenario, not an empirically calibrated population profile or a diagnosis of the original drawing's author.
initial_state_source: Shared case_config.initial_conceptual_state (categorical misconception_type and knowledge_components) and case_config.initial_explanation.
